answer: Submission-graph structural anomaly audit resists sybils: the system models the graph of which identities submit to which challenge instances in what order, and flags anomalous subgraphs — identities that submit in lockstep or mirror each other's targets. A tide of honest agents produces an irregular well-mixed graph; a pearl-string of fakes from one controller forms a rigid synchronized substructure. Normal garden activity has high structural entropy; the lockstep sybil subgraph is a topological signature routing members to targeted re-grade.
